guide.summary: English uses a few all-purpose verbs (play, wear, take, do, have); Chinese picks the verb from what you physically do: you hit (打) a basketball but kick (踢) a football, flick (弹) piano keys but bow (拉) a violin, put on (戴) glasses but get into (穿) a coat, sit (坐) in a bus but straddle (骑) a bike. Never translate the English verb: picture the action, and learn each noun together with its verb as one unit.

subs.label: 打 and 'play': 打篮球, 踢足球, 弹钢琴, 打电话
subs.focus: 打 for hand or racket ball games (篮球, 网球, 乒乓球), 踢足球, 弹钢琴 / 吉他, 拉小提琴, 下棋. Errors: 打足球, 踢篮球, 打钢琴, 弹小提琴. Never key 玩 + ball or instrument as wrong. Other 打: 打电话 (给 + person goes before it), 打车 'take a taxi', 打针, 打伞, 打工.

subs.label: 穿 / 戴 / 系: clothes, accessories, ties
subs.focus: 穿 for clothes, trousers, skirts, shoes and socks; 戴 for hats, glasses, watches, masks, gloves and rings; 系 (jì) for ties, seat belts and shoelaces. Errors to test: 穿眼镜, 穿帽子, 穿手表, 穿口罩, 戴衣服, 戴鞋, 穿领带. Avoid 围巾 (戴, 围 and 系 are all used). 打领带 equals 系领带 and 戴领带 is heard: never key them wrong.

subs.label: 坐 / 骑 / 开 / 乘, and 开会, 开灯, 开玩笑
subs.focus: 坐 as a passenger (车, 地铁, 火车, 飞机), 骑 astride (自行车, 马), 开 as the driver, 乘 = formal 坐. Errors: 骑公共汽车, 开自行车, 骑出租车. (坐马车 'ride in a carriage' is right.) 坐自行车 (riding on the back) is not wrong. 开 also: 开会, 开灯 / 开空调, 开玩笑 'kid, tease' (telling a joke is 讲笑话).

subs.label: 看 / 读 / 念, and 吃药, 喝汤, 抽烟
subs.focus: 看 for silent reading, watching and the doctor: 看书, 看电视, 看病, 看医生; 读 / 念 for reading aloud (读课文) and 'study at' (读大学). Error: 读电视. 读书, 读报, 读小说 (silent reading) are also correct: never key them wrong. Mouth verbs: 吃药, 喝汤, 喝水, 抽烟; errors 喝饭, 喝烟. Never key 喝药 (herbal medicine) or 吃汤 (dialectal) as wrong.

subs.label: 做 / 办 / 干 / 搞: which 'do'
subs.focus: 做 for 饭, 菜, 作业, 梦, 生意; 办 for 手续, 签证, 护照, 事; 干 is spoken 'do' (干什么, 干活); 搞 is casual (搞清楚: level 3, cloze only). Errors: 办作业, 办饭, 做了一个梦 vs 有了一个梦 (cloze only, never a judge item). 做签证 is common in speech: never key it wrong; drill 办 with 手续 and 事. Never set 干什么 against 做什么: both are right.

subs.label: 上 / 下: 上班, 下课, 下雨, 下决心
subs.focus: 上 starts or attends a regular activity: 上课, 上班, 上学, 上网, 上大学; 下 ends it: 下课, 下班. Weather falls with 下: 下雨, 下雪 (no 'it' and no 是). 下决心 'make up one's mind'. Errors: 外面在雨, 今天雨了, 我八点去班 (needs 上班), 下大学 (finishing university is 毕业). Note 上课 means both 'go to class' and 'class starts'.

subs.label: 发 / 寄 / 送; 提 / 回答 / 解决 问题
subs.focus: 发 for electronic or handed-out things: 发邮件, 发短信, 发工资, and 发烧 'have a fever'; 寄 only by post: 寄信, 寄包裹; 送 for gifts and deliveries. Errors: 寄短信, 寄微信. Never key 寄邮件 as wrong. 提问题 / 意见 / 要求, 回答问题, 解决问题: the context must show question versus problem.

subs.label: 照相 / 拍照, 洗澡 / 刷牙 / 梳头, 过生日 / 度假
subs.focus: Photos: 照相, 拍照, 拍照片; films: 拍电影 (errors 拿照片, 照电影). Grooming: 洗澡, 洗脸, 洗头, 刷牙, 梳头 (errors 洗牙 for brushing, 刷头). 过生日, 过年, 过周末, 过马路, 度假. Do not key 做生日 wrong (regional but real) and do not offer 做 or 度 as distractors to 过生日; use 开 or 打. 庆祝生日 is correct: never key it wrong.

subs.label: 起 / 取, 生, 留
subs.focus: 起床 'get up' (站起来 is 'stand up'); 起名字 = 取名字, so never offer them as rivals. 取钱, 取票, 取包裹 'collect, withdraw'. 生气, 生病, 生孩子. 留作业 'set homework', 留言, 去 + country + 留学. Errors: 起钱, 取床.

subs.label: 浓茶, 大雨, 重病, 深色: the right adjective
subs.focus: 浓 / 淡 for tea and coffee; 大 / 小 for rain, snow, wind and voices; 重 / 轻 for illness and injury; 深 / 浅 for colours, 深 for impressions. Errors: 茶很强, 雨很重, 重雨. Avoid 声音高 in items (it can mean pitch or volume). Never key 严重, 强风 or 淡蓝色 as wrong.

rules.rule: Pick the verb by the body movement: hand or racket ball games take 打, football is kicked with 踢, piano and guitar take 弹 'flick, pluck', the violin is bowed with 拉, and chess pieces are put down with 下.
rules.pattern: 打 + ball game | 踢足球 | 弹 + keyboard or guitar | 拉 + violin | 下棋

examples.zh: 我周末常常跟朋友打篮球。
examples.py: wǒ zhōu mò cháng cháng gēn péng you dǎ lán qiú
examples.en: I often play basketball with friends at weekends.

examples.py: dì di xǐ huan tī zú qiú
examples.en: My little brother likes playing football.

examples.py: tā cóng wǔ suì kāi shǐ tán gāng qín
examples.en: She has played the piano since she was five.

examples.zh: 爷爷每天下午在公园下棋。
examples.py: yé ye měi tiān xià wǔ zài gōng yuán xià qí
examples.en: Grandpa plays chess in the park every afternoon.

rules.note: 拉小提琴 for the violin, 吹 for wind instruments. 打牌 is 'play cards'; video games are 玩游戏 or, casually, 打游戏.

rules.rule: 打 is the busiest verb in Chinese: 打电话 'make a phone call', 打车 'take a taxi', 打针 'have or give an injection', 打伞 'hold up an umbrella', 打工 'work a (part-time) job'.
rules.pattern: 给 + person + 打电话 | 打车 + 去 + place | 打针 | 打伞 | 在 + place + 打工

examples.py: wǒ xià le bān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you after work.

examples.zh: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
examples.py: tài wǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē huí jiā ba
examples.en: It's too late, let's get a taxi home.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了，出去记得打伞。
examples.py: wài miàn xià yǔ le chū qù jì de dǎ sǎn
examples.en: It's raining outside; remember to use an umbrella when you go out.

examples.py: tā shǔ jià zài fàn guǎn dǎ gōng
examples.en: He works part-time in a restaurant during the summer holiday.

rules.note: The person you call goes before the verb with 给, never after 打电话. 打针 is the same phrase for the nurse and the patient: 护士给我打了一针 'the nurse gave me an injection'.

rules.rule: 穿 for what you get into (clothes, trousers, shoes, socks); 戴 for what you put on or attach (hat, glasses, watch, mask, gloves, ring); 系 (jì) for what you tie (tie, seat belt, shoelaces).
rules.pattern: 穿 + clothes or shoes | 戴 + accessory | 系 + tie or belt

examples.zh: 今天很冷，多穿点儿衣服。
examples.py: jīn tiān hěn lěng duō chuān diǎn r yī fu
examples.en: It's cold today, put on some more clothes.

examples.py: tā dài zhe yī fù yǎn jìng
examples.en: He wears glasses.

examples.zh: 出门的时候别忘了戴口罩。
examples.py: chū mén de shí hou bié wàng le dài kǒu zhào
examples.en: Don't forget to wear a mask when you go out.

examples.py: bà ba shàng bān yào jì lǐng dài
examples.en: Dad has to wear a tie to work.

rules.note: 系 is read jì when it means 'tie' (xì in 关系). A tie can also be 打: 打领带. Taking things off: 脱 for clothes and shoes, 摘 for glasses, a watch or a mask; a hat can take either.

rules.rule: 坐 if you sit inside as a passenger, 骑 if you sit astride, 开 if you are the driver. 乘 is a formal, written 坐.
rules.pattern: 坐 + bus / train / plane | 骑 + bike / horse | 开车

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
examples.en: I take the subway to work every day.

examples.py: tā qí zì xíng chē qù xué xiào
examples.en: He rides his bike to school.

examples.py: wǒ hái bù huì kāi chē
examples.en: I can't drive yet.

examples.zh: 我们明天乘飞机去北京。
examples.py: wǒ men míng tiān chéng fēi jī qù běi jīng
examples.en: We're flying to Beijing tomorrow.

rules.note: 坐自行车 is not wrong but means riding on the back as a passenger. 坐飞机 is flying as a passenger; 开飞机 is piloting it. Getting on and off is 上车 and 下车.

rules.rule: 开 also means 'switch on' (开灯, 开空调, 开电视), 'hold or attend a meeting' (开会), and in 开玩笑 'joke, kid'. Switching off is 关.
rules.pattern: 开 / 关 + 灯, 空调, 电视 | 开会 | 跟 + person + 开玩笑

examples.py: fáng jiān tài hēi le kāi dēng ba
examples.en: The room is too dark, turn on the light.

examples.py: wǒ men xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi huì
examples.en: We have a meeting at three this afternoon.

examples.zh: 别生气，我跟你开玩笑呢。
examples.py: bié shēng qì wǒ gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào ne
examples.en: Don't be angry, I'm only joking.

rules.note: 开玩笑 is teasing or kidding; telling a joke is 讲笑话 or 说笑话. 他在开会 means 'he's in a meeting'.

rules.rule: 看 covers reading, watching and seeing a doctor; 读 and 念 are reading aloud or studying at a school (读书 'read' is fine too). For the mouth: 吃 for food and pills, 喝 for drinks and soup, 抽 for cigarettes.
rules.pattern: 看 + 书 / 电视 / 电影 / 病 / 医生 | 读 / 念 + 课文 | 吃药, 喝汤, 抽烟

examples.zh: 我晚上喜欢在床上看书。
examples.py: wǒ wǎn shang xǐ huan zài chuáng shang kàn shū
examples.en: In the evening I like reading in bed.

examples.zh: 你不舒服就去看医生吧。
examples.py: nǐ bù shū fu jiù qù kàn yī shēng ba
examples.en: If you don't feel well, go and see a doctor.

examples.py: zhè ge yào yī tiān chī sān cì
examples.en: Take this medicine three times a day.

examples.py: wǒ bà ba bù chōu yān
examples.en: My dad doesn't smoke.

rules.note: 看病 works from both sides: 我去看病 'I go to the doctor', 医生给病人看病 'the doctor treats patients'. Soup is drunk: 喝汤. Herbal medicine boiled into a drink is 喝中药. Signs say 禁止吸烟.

rules.rule: 做 for making and doing (饭, 菜, 作业, 梦, 生意); 办 for formalities and errands (手续, 签证, 事); 干 and 搞 are casual spoken 'do'.
rules.pattern: 做 + 饭 / 作业 / 梦 / 生意 | 办 + 手续 / 签证 / 事 | 干什么

examples.py: mā ma zài chú fáng zuò fàn
examples.en: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上做了一个奇怪的梦。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zuò le yī gè qí guài de mèng
examples.en: I had a strange dream last night.

examples.zh: 去中国以前要先办签证。
examples.py: qù zhōng guó yǐ qián yào xiān bàn qiān zhèng
examples.en: You need to get a visa before going to China.

examples.py: nǐ zhōu mò yī bān gàn shén me
examples.en: What do you usually do at weekends?

rules.note: A dream is 'made', not 'had': 做梦. 做生意 is 'do business'. 搞 is casual (我还没搞清楚 'I haven't figured it out yet'); in writing and polite speech prefer 做.

rules.rule: 上 starts or attends a regular activity (上课, 上班, 上学, 上网, 上大学) and 下 ends it (下课, 下班). Rain and snow 'come down': 下雨, 下雪. 下决心 is 'make up your mind'.
rules.pattern: 上 / 下 + 课, 班 | 上网, 上大学 | 下雨, 下雪 | 下决心

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang bā diǎn shàng bān
examples.en: I start work at eight every morning.

examples.zh: 下课以后我们去打球吧。
examples.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
examples.en: Let's go and play ball after class.

examples.py: wài miàn zài xià xuě
examples.en: It's snowing outside.

examples.py: tā xià jué xīn xué hǎo zhōng wén
examples.en: He made up his mind to learn Chinese properly.

rules.note: There is no 'it' and no 是 in weather: 下雨了 'it's raining'. 上课 means both 'go to class' and 'class starts'. Finishing university is 毕业, not 下大学.

rules.rule: 发 for anything electronic or handed out, 寄 only for things that go through the post, 送 for presents and deliveries. 问题 is both 'question' and 'problem': 提 raises it, 回答 answers a question, 解决 solves a problem.
rules.pattern: 发 + 邮件 / 短信 / 工资 | 寄 + 信 / 包裹 | 提 + 问题 / 意见 / 要求 | 回答问题 | 解决问题

examples.zh: 我昨天给你发了一封邮件。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi nǐ fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn
examples.en: I sent you an email yesterday.

examples.zh: 我想给妈妈寄一个包裹。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma jì yī gè bāo guǒ
examples.en: I want to post a parcel to my mum.

examples.zh: 开会的时候他提了很多意见。
examples.py: kāi huì de shí hou tā tí le hěn duō yì jiàn
examples.en: He made a lot of suggestions at the meeting.

examples.zh: 这个问题我们一定能解决。
examples.py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ men yī dìng néng jiě jué
examples.en: We can definitely solve this problem.

rules.note: 发烧 is 'have a fever' (孩子发烧了). 发工资 is 'pay wages'. 送 a present: 他送了我一本书. 问 + person + 问题 is also correct: 我可以问你一个问题吗？

rules.rule: Photos are taken with 照 or 拍 and films are shot with 拍. Grooming has its own verbs: 洗澡, 洗脸, 洗头, 刷牙, 梳头. Occasions and roads are 'passed': 过生日, 过年, 过马路; a holiday is 度假.
rules.pattern: 照相 / 拍照 / 拍电影 | 洗澡, 刷牙, 梳头 | 过 + 生日 / 年 / 马路 | 度假

examples.zh: 我们在这里拍张照片吧。
examples.py: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ pāi zhāng zhào piàn ba
examples.en: Let's take a photo here.

examples.py: shuì jiào yǐ qián bié wàng le shuā yá
examples.en: Don't forget to brush your teeth before bed.

examples.zh: 你今年打算怎么过生日？
examples.py: nǐ jīn nián dǎ suàn zěn me guò shēng rì
examples.en: How are you planning to celebrate your birthday this year?

examples.py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou yào xiǎo xīn
examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road.

rules.note: 照相 and 拍照 take no object: 给我照张相, 给他拍照. 洗牙 is a cleaning at the dentist, not brushing. 度假: 他们去海边度假了 'they went on holiday to the seaside'.

rules.rule: 起床 'get up' and 起名字 'give a name'; 取 alone is 'collect, withdraw' (取钱, 取票). 生 is 'produce': 生气, 生病, 生孩子. 留 is 'leave for someone': 留作业, 留言, and 留学 'study abroad'.
rules.pattern: 起床 | 给 + person + 起名字 | 取钱 | 生气 / 生病 / 生孩子 | 给 + person + 留作业 / 留言 | 去 + country + 留学

examples.py: nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng
examples.en: What time do you get up every day?

examples.py: wǒ yào qù yín háng qǔ qián
examples.en: I need to go to the bank to take out some money.

examples.zh: 她上个月生了一个女儿。
examples.py: tā shàng gè yuè shēng le yī gè nǚ ér
examples.en: She had a baby girl last month.

examples.zh: 老师今天给我们留了很多作业。
examples.py: lǎo shī jīn tiān gěi wǒ men liú le hěn duō zuò yè
examples.en: The teacher gave us a lot of homework today.

rules.note: 起名字 and 取名字 are both correct. 站起来 is 'stand up', not 'get up in the morning'. 生气 puts the person inside: 生我的气.

rules.rule: Strength and size are not translated word for word: tea and coffee are 浓 or 淡; rain, snow, wind and voices are 大 or 小; illness and injuries are 重 or 轻; colours are 深 or 浅, and an impression is 深.
rules.pattern: 浓 / 淡 + 茶 | 雨 / 风 / 声音 + 大 / 小 | 病 / 伤 + 重 / 轻 | 深 / 浅 + colour

examples.py: wǎn shang bié hē tài nóng de chá
examples.en: Don't drink very strong tea in the evening.

examples.py: wài miàn yǔ xià de hěn dà
examples.en: It's raining heavily outside.

examples.zh: 他的病不重，休息几天就好了。
examples.py: tā de bìng bù zhòng xiū xi jǐ tiān jiù hǎo le
examples.en: His illness isn't serious; he'll be fine after a few days' rest.

examples.zh: 我喜欢浅蓝色，不喜欢深蓝色。
examples.py: wǒ xǐ huan qiǎn lán sè bù xǐ huan shēn lán sè
examples.en: I like light blue, not dark blue.

rules.note: 这个城市给我留下了很深的印象 'this city made a deep impression on me'. 淡 also means 'bland' for food (这个菜太淡了) and 'pale' for colours (淡黄色). 'Loud' is 声音大; 声音高 is ambiguous and often means high-pitched.

right.py: wǒ xǐ huan tī zú qiú

contrasts.why: Football is kicked, so it takes 踢. 打 is for ball games played with the hands or a racket: 打篮球, 打网球.
Keys and strings that you press or pluck take 弹 (弹钢琴, 弹吉他). Bowed strings take 拉: 拉小提琴.

right.py: tā dài zhe yī fù yǎn jìng

contrasts.why: 穿 is only for things you get into, like clothes and shoes. Glasses, hats, watches and masks are 戴.

contrasts.wrong: 我每天骑公共汽车上班。

right.zh: 我每天坐公共汽车上班。
right.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē shàng bān
right.en: I take the bus to work every day.

contrasts.why: You sit inside a bus as a passenger, so it is 坐. 骑 is only for things you straddle: bikes, motorbikes, horses.
雨 is a noun, not a verb. Rain and snow need 下 'come down': 下雨, 下雪.

right.py: wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn
right.en: I sent you a text message.

contrasts.why: 寄 is only for things that physically go through the post (letters, parcels). Anything electronic is 发.

contrasts.wrong: 我们在这里拿一张照片吧。

right.zh: 我们在这里拍一张照片吧。
right.py: wǒ men zài zhè lǐ pāi yī zhāng zhào piàn ba

contrasts.why: English 'take' does not carry over: 拿照片 means picking up a printed photo. Taking one is 拍 or 照 (拍照, 照相).

right.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang shuā yá
right.en: I brush my teeth every morning.

contrasts.why: Teeth are brushed with 刷. 洗牙 exists, but it means a professional cleaning at the dentist, not your daily brushing.

contrasts.wrong: 他给我们开了一个笑话。

right.zh: 他给我们讲了一个笑话。
right.py: tā gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yī gè xiào hua

contrasts.why: 开 only goes with 玩笑: 开玩笑 'kid, tease'. Telling a joke is 讲 or 说: 讲笑话, 说笑话.

right.py: zhè bēi chá tài nóng le

contrasts.why: Strong tea or coffee is 浓 and weak is 淡. 强 describes power or ability, never a drink.

cheat: Hand or racket ball: 打. Football: 踢. Piano, guitar: 弹. Violin: 拉. Chess: 下.
Get into it (clothes, shoes): 穿. Put it on (hat, glasses, watch, mask): 戴. Tie it: 系 jì.
Sit inside: 坐. Sit astride: 骑. Drive: 开. Light, AC, TV: 开 and 关.
Read, watch, see a doctor: 看. Pills: 吃. Soup and drinks: 喝. Cigarettes: 抽.
Electronic: 发. By post: 寄. Answer a question: 回答. Solve a problem: 解决.
Rain and snow: 下. Class and work: 上 to start, 下 to finish. Dreams and dinner: 做. Visas: 办.
Heavy rain, strong wind, loud voice: 大. Strong tea: 浓. Serious illness: 重. Dark colour: 深.

items.q: 我下班以后常常去公司楼下___篮球。
items.zh: 我下班以后常常去公司楼下打篮球。
items.py: wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu cháng cháng qù gōng sī lóu xià dǎ lán qiú
items.en: After work I often play basketball downstairs from the office.
items.why: Basketball is a hand ball game, so it takes 打. 踢 is for football and 弹 for keys or strings.

items.q: 邻居家的孩子每天晚上都在___钢琴。
items.zh: 邻居家的孩子每天晚上都在弹钢琴。
items.py: lín jū jiā de hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài tán gāng qín
items.en: The neighbours' child plays the piano every evening.
items.why: Piano keys are pressed, so the verb is 弹. 打 is for ball games and 拉 for the violin; neither goes with 钢琴.

items.s: 周末我们去公园踢篮球。
items.s_py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán tī lán qiú
items.zh: 周末我们去公园打篮球。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù gōng yuán dǎ lán qiú
items.en: At the weekend we go to the park to play basketball.
items.why: Basketball is a hand ball game, so it takes 打. 踢 is only for football and other kicking games.

items.q: 楼上的邻居会___小提琴，我们晚上常常能听到。
items.zh: 楼上的邻居会拉小提琴，我们晚上常常能听到。
items.py: lóu shàng de lín jū huì lā xiǎo tí qín wǒ men wǎn shang cháng cháng néng tīng dào
items.en: The neighbour upstairs plays the violin, and we often hear it in the evening.
items.why: The violin is bowed, so it takes 拉. 弹 is for piano and guitar, and 吹 is for wind instruments.

items.q: 吃完晚饭，爷爷和邻居在楼下___棋。
items.zh: 吃完晚饭，爷爷和邻居在楼下下棋。
items.py: chī wán wǎn fàn yé ye hé lín jū zài lóu xià xià qí
items.en: After dinner Grandpa plays chess with a neighbour downstairs.
items.why: Chess is 下棋: the pieces are put down on the board. 打 is for ball games and 弹 for instruments, so neither is said with 棋.

items.s: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
items.zh: 太晚了，我们打车回家吧。
items.py: tài wǎn le wǒ men dǎ chē huí jiā ba
items.en: It is too late; let us take a taxi home.
items.why: 打车 is the normal way to say "take a taxi", with 打 as in hailing one. It is correct even though English uses "take".

items.q: 我的手机没电了，能借你的手机给家里___个电话吗？
items.zh: 我的手机没电了，能借你的手机给家里打个电话吗？
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn le néng jiè nǐ de shǒu jī gěi jiā lǐ dǎ gè diàn huà ma
items.en: My phone is out of battery. Could I borrow yours to call home?
items.why: A phone call is made with 打: 打电话. 做 is the English "make" and does not work here, and 发 is for messages and email.

items.q: 孩子发烧了，医生让他去医院___针。
items.zh: 孩子发烧了，医生让他去医院打针。
items.py: hái zi fā shāo le yī shēng ràng tā qù yī yuàn dǎ zhēn
items.en: The child has a fever, and the doctor told him to go to the hospital for an injection.
items.why: An injection is 打针. 吃 is for pills and food, so 吃针 is impossible, and 做针 does not exist.

items.s: 妈妈给孩子穿了一顶红帽子。
items.s_py: mā ma gěi hái zi chuān le yī dǐng hóng mào zi
items.zh: 妈妈给孩子戴了一顶红帽子。
items.py: mā ma gěi hái zi dài le yī dǐng hóng mào zi
items.en: Mum put a red hat on the child.
items.why: A hat is put on the head, so it takes 戴. 穿 is for clothes and shoes that you get into, so 穿帽子 is wrong.

items.q: 公园里有几个小孩在___足球。
items.zh: 公园里有几个小孩在踢足球。
items.py: gōng yuán lǐ yǒu jǐ gè xiǎo hái zài tī zú qiú
items.en: A few children are playing football in the park.
items.why: Football is kicked, so it is 踢足球. 打足球 is a typical learner error: 打 is for games played with the hands or a racket.

items.q: 天气冷了，出门要___厚外套。
items.zh: 天气冷了，出门要穿厚外套。
items.py: tiān qì lěng le chū mén yào chuān hòu wài tào
items.en: It is getting cold; wear a thick coat when you go out.
items.why: A coat is something you get into, so it takes 穿. 戴 is for hats and glasses, and 系 is for ties or belts.

items.q: 他的眼睛不好，平时都___着一副眼镜。
items.zh: 他的眼睛不好，平时都戴着一副眼镜。
items.py: tā de yǎn jing bù hǎo píng shí dōu dài zhe yī fù yǎn jìng
items.en: His eyesight is poor, so he usually wears glasses.
items.why: Glasses are put on the face, so they take 戴. 穿眼镜 is a classic error: 穿 is only for clothes and shoes you get into.

items.s: 他穿着一双旧皮鞋，戴着一块旧手表。
items.zh: 他穿着一双旧皮鞋，戴着一块旧手表。
items.py: tā chuān zhe yī shuāng jiù pí xié dài zhe yī kuài jiù shǒu biǎo
items.en: He is wearing an old pair of leather shoes and an old watch.
items.why: Both verbs are right: shoes take 穿 and a watch takes 戴, even though English says "wear" for both.

items.q: 医生进手术室以前，要先___上口罩。
items.zh: 医生进手术室以前，要先戴上口罩。
items.py: yī shēng jìn shǒu shù shì yǐ qián yào xiān dài shàng kǒu zhào
items.en: Before going into the operating room the doctor first puts on a mask.
items.why: A mask is put on the face, so it takes 戴 (戴上 "put on"). 穿 is for clothes, and 围 is for a scarf wrapped round the neck, not for a mask.

items.q: 面试的时候，他___了一条蓝色的领带。
items.zh: 面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
items.py: miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
items.en: At the interview he wore a blue tie.
items.why: A tie is tied, so it takes 系 (read jì). 穿 is only for clothes you get into, so 穿领带 is wrong.

items.s: 下班以后，我骑公共汽车回家。
items.s_py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ qí gōng gòng qì chē huí jiā
items.zh: 下班以后，我坐公共汽车回家。
items.py: xià bān yǐ hòu wǒ zuò gōng gòng qì chē huí jiā
items.en: After work I take the bus home.
items.why: You sit inside a bus as a passenger, so it takes 坐. 骑 is only for things you sit astride, like a bike or a horse.

items.q: 你的鞋带松了，快___好。
items.zh: 你的鞋带松了，快系好。
items.py: nǐ de xié dài sōng le kuài jì hǎo
items.en: Your shoelace has come loose; tie it up quickly.
items.why: Laces are tied, so 系好 (jì hǎo). 戴 is for hats and glasses and 穿 for clothes and shoes, so neither can fasten a lace.

items.q: 商店里的裙子很漂亮，我想___上试试。
items.zh: 商店里的裙子很漂亮，我想穿上试试。
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ de qún zi hěn piào liang wǒ xiǎng chuān shàng shì shi
items.en: The skirts in the shop are lovely; I want to try one on.
items.why: A skirt is something you get into, so 穿上. 戴 is for hats, glasses and watches, and 系 for things you tie.

items.s: 我哥哥每天开自行车去公司。
items.s_py: wǒ gē ge měi tiān kāi zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
items.zh: 我哥哥每天骑自行车去公司。
items.py: wǒ gē ge měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
items.en: My older brother cycles to the office every day.
items.why: You ride a bike by sitting astride it, so 骑. 开 is for driving a car or other vehicle with an engine.

items.q: 他手腕上___着一块很贵的手表。
items.zh: 他手腕上戴着一块很贵的手表。
items.py: tā shǒu wàn shàng dài zhe yī kuài hěn guì de shǒu biǎo
items.en: He is wearing a very expensive watch on his wrist.
items.why: A watch is put on the wrist, so it takes 戴. 穿手表 is wrong: 穿 is only for clothes and shoes you get into.

items.q: 我的运动鞋湿了，今天只能___皮鞋去上班。
items.zh: 我的运动鞋湿了，今天只能穿皮鞋去上班。
items.py: wǒ de yùn dòng xié shī le jīn tiān zhǐ néng chuān pí xié qù shàng bān
items.en: My trainers are wet, so today I can only wear leather shoes to work.
items.why: Shoes are something you put your feet into, so 穿. 戴 is for things worn on the head, face or wrist, and 系 would only fit the laces.

items.q: 我家离公司很远，我每天___地铁上班。
items.zh: 我家离公司很远，我每天坐地铁上班。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn yuǎn wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
items.en: My home is far from the office, so I take the subway to work every day.
items.why: A passenger sits inside the subway, so it is 坐. 骑 is for things you straddle, and 开 is only for the driver, which a subway rider is not.

items.s: 下午的会已经开了两个小时了。
items.zh: 下午的会已经开了两个小时了。
items.py: xià wǔ de huì yǐ jīng kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí le
items.en: The afternoon meeting has already been going for two hours.
items.why: 开会 is the fixed pair for holding or attending a meeting, and the duration 两个小时 follows the verb 开了.

items.q: 我家离超市很近，我常常___自行车去买菜。
items.zh: 我家离超市很近，我常常骑自行车去买菜。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí chāo shì hěn jìn wǒ cháng cháng qí zì xíng chē qù mǎi cài
items.en: My home is close to the supermarket, so I often cycle there to buy food.
items.why: You sit astride a bike, so it is 骑自行车. 开 is for driving vehicles with an engine or steering wheel, and 开自行车 is a typical learner error.

items.q: 我爸爸在一家公司当司机，每天都___公司的车接送经理。
items.zh: 我爸爸在一家公司当司机，每天都开公司的车接送经理。
items.py: wǒ bà ba zài yī jiā gōng sī dāng sī jī měi tiān dōu kāi gōng sī de chē jiē sòng jīng lǐ
items.en: My dad is a driver at a company and drives the company car to pick up and drop off the manager every day.
items.why: A driver drives the car, so 开. 坐 would make him a passenger, which contradicts 当司机, and 骑 is for bikes and horses.

items.s: 晚上我喜欢在家读电视。
items.s_py: wǎn shang wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā dú diàn shì
items.zh: 晚上我喜欢在家看电视。
items.py: wǎn shang wǒ xǐ huan zài jiā kàn diàn shì
items.en: In the evening I like to watch TV at home.
items.why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 is for reading text aloud or studying at a school, never for watching.

items.q: 房间里太黑了，你能帮我把灯___一下吗？
items.zh: 房间里太黑了，你能帮我把灯开一下吗？
items.py: fáng jiān lǐ tài hēi le nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ dēng kāi yī xià ma
items.en: It is too dark in the room; could you turn on the light for me?
items.why: Switching a light on is 开灯. 关 would switch it off, which makes no sense in a dark room, and 打 alone cannot do it: you would need 打开.

items.q: 别当真，我只是跟你___玩笑。
items.zh: 别当真，我只是跟你开玩笑。
items.py: bié dàng zhēn wǒ zhǐ shì gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào
items.en: Don't take it seriously; I was only joking with you.
items.why: Teasing someone is 开玩笑, a fixed phrase with 开. 讲 and 说 work with 笑话 (tell a joke) but not with 玩笑.

items.s: 他感冒了，所以今天在家喝汤吃药。
items.zh: 他感冒了，所以今天在家喝汤吃药。
items.py: tā gǎn mào le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān zài jiā hē tāng chī yào
items.en: He has a cold, so today he is at home drinking soup and taking medicine.
items.why: Soup is drunk (喝汤) and pills are eaten (吃药). Chinese uses these mouth verbs where English says "take medicine".

items.q: 我们明天上午要___飞机去上海出差。
items.zh: 我们明天上午要坐飞机去上海出差。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān shàng wǔ yào zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
items.en: Tomorrow morning we are flying to Shanghai on a business trip.
items.why: Passengers sit inside a plane, so it is 坐飞机. 开飞机 is for the pilot, and 骑 is for things you sit astride.

items.q: 办公室太热了，我们___空调吧。
items.zh: 办公室太热了，我们开空调吧。
items.py: bàn gōng shì tài rè le wǒ men kāi kōng tiáo ba
items.en: The office is too hot; let us switch on the air conditioning.
items.why: Switching on the air conditioning is 开空调, and 开 also means "switch on". 关 means switch off, which does not help a hot room.

items.q: 我头疼得很厉害，下午想去医院___病。
items.zh: 我头疼得很厉害，下午想去医院看病。
items.py: wǒ tóu téng de hěn lì hai xià wǔ xiǎng qù yī yuàn kàn bìng
items.en: My head hurts badly; this afternoon I want to go to the hospital to see a doctor.
items.why: Going to be examined is 看病, the same 看 as in 看医生. 吃 and 喝 are for the mouth: they need food, drink or medicine as an object, not 病.

items.s: 饭馆里不能喝烟，请到外面去。
items.s_py: fàn guǎn lǐ bù néng hē yān qǐng dào wài miàn qù
items.zh: 饭馆里不能抽烟，请到外面去。
items.py: fàn guǎn lǐ bù néng chōu yān qǐng dào wài miàn qù
items.en: You can't smoke in the restaurant; please go outside.
items.why: Cigarettes are 抽 ("draw on"), not 喝. 喝 is for liquids such as water, tea and soup.

items.q: 这种药饭后___，一次两片。
items.zh: 这种药饭后吃，一次两片。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào fàn hòu chī yī cì liǎng piàn
items.en: Take this medicine after meals, two tablets at a time.
items.why: Pills are eaten in Chinese: 吃药. 抽 is for cigarettes and 打 for injections, so neither fits tablets.

items.q: 医生说他身体不好，不能再___烟了。
items.zh: 医生说他身体不好，不能再抽烟了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā shēn tǐ bù hǎo bù néng zài chōu yān le
items.en: The doctor says his health is poor and he must not smoke any more.
items.why: Cigarettes are 抽烟 ("draw"). 喝 is for liquids and 吃 for food; 喝烟 is wrong and 吃烟 is not standard Mandarin.

items.s: 妈妈在厨房里办晚饭。
items.s_py: mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ bàn wǎn fàn
items.zh: 妈妈在厨房里做晚饭。
items.py: mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ zuò wǎn fàn
items.en: Mum is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
items.why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands such as 办手续, never for food.

items.q: 我爸爸晚饭后喜欢坐在沙发上___电视。
items.zh: 我爸爸晚饭后喜欢坐在沙发上看电视。
items.py: wǒ bà ba wǎn fàn hòu xǐ huan zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn diàn shì
items.en: After dinner my dad likes sitting on the sofa watching TV.
items.why: Watching television is 看电视. 读 and 念 are for reading text aloud or studying at a school, so 读电视 is wrong.

items.q: 老师让我们大声___课文。
items.zh: 老师让我们大声念课文。
items.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men dà shēng niàn kè wén
items.en: The teacher asks us to read the text aloud.
items.why: 大声 means "loudly", so the verb is reading aloud: 念 (or 读). 看 is silent looking, and 写 is writing, which cannot be done loudly.

items.s: 他毕业以后在网上做生意，做得不错。
items.zh: 他毕业以后在网上做生意，做得不错。
items.py: tā bì yè yǐ hòu zài wǎng shàng zuò shēng yi zuò de bú cuò
items.en: After graduating he went into online business and is doing quite well.
items.why: 做生意 is the standard pair for doing business, and 做得不错 repeats the verb with 得 to describe how well he does it.

items.q: 我姐姐在北京___大学，学的是中文。
items.zh: 我姐姐在北京读大学，学的是中文。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie zài běi jīng dú dà xué xué de shì zhōng wén
items.en: My older sister is at university in Beijing, studying Chinese.
items.why: 读 also means to study at a school: 读大学. 看大学 would mean looking at a university, and 喝 has nothing to do with it.

items.q: 你感冒了，多___点儿热水。
items.zh: 你感冒了，多喝点儿热水。
items.py: nǐ gǎn mào le duō hē diǎn r rè shuǐ
items.en: You have a cold; drink more hot water.
items.why: Water is drunk: 喝水. 吃 is for food and pills, and 抽 is for cigarettes.

items.q: 我今天加班，回家太晚了，没有时间___饭。
items.zh: 我今天加班，回家太晚了，没有时间做饭。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān jiā bān huí jiā tài wǎn le méi yǒu shí jiān zuò fàn
items.en: I worked overtime today and got home too late to cook.
items.why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands (办手续), never for food.

items.s: 我弟弟还没办作业，不能出去玩。
items.s_py: wǒ dì di hái méi bàn zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
items.zh: 我弟弟还没做作业，不能出去玩。
items.py: wǒ dì di hái méi zuò zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
items.en: My younger brother hasn't done his homework yet, so he can't go out to play.
items.why: Homework is 做作业. 办 is for formalities and errands, not for schoolwork.

items.q: 新同事今天来公司报到，要先___入职手续。
items.zh: 新同事今天来公司报到，要先办入职手续。
items.py: xīn tóng shì jīn tiān lái gōng sī bào dào yào xiān bàn rù zhí shǒu xù
items.en: The new colleague is reporting to the company today and must first complete the joining formalities.
items.why: Formalities take 办: 办手续. 开 goes with 会, 灯 and 证明 'issue a certificate', not 手续, and 打 does not go with 手续 either.

items.q: 我昨天太累了，晚上___了一个很长的梦。
items.zh: 我昨天太累了，晚上做了一个很长的梦。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān tài lèi le wǎn shang zuò le yī gè hěn cháng de mèng
items.en: I was very tired yesterday and had a very long dream at night.
items.why: A dream is "made" in Chinese: 做梦. 有了一个梦 sounds like acquiring a dream or an ambition, not dreaming in your sleep.

items.s: 外面在雨，我们别出去了。
items.s_py: wài miàn zài yǔ wǒ men bié chū qù le
items.zh: 外面在下雨，我们别出去了。
items.py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ wǒ men bié chū qù le
items.en: It is raining outside; let us not go out.
items.why: 雨 is a noun, not a verb. Rain "comes down", so the verb 下 is needed: 在下雨.

items.q: 这家饭馆的厨师很会___菜，客人特别多。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的厨师很会做菜，客人特别多。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de chú shī hěn huì zuò cài kè rén tè bié duō
items.en: The chef at this restaurant cooks very well, so there are lots of customers.
items.why: Cooking dishes is 做菜. 办 is for errands and formalities, and 打 is for ball games and calls.

items.q: 他想在城里开一家饭馆，自己___生意。
items.zh: 他想在城里开一家饭馆，自己做生意。
items.py: tā xiǎng zài chéng lǐ kāi yī jiā fàn guǎn zì jǐ zuò shēng yi
items.en: He wants to open a restaurant in the city and run his own business.
items.why: Running a business is 做生意, a fixed pair. 办生意 is not said, and 吃 cannot take 生意.

items.s: 我们公司五点半下班，我六点半才能到家。
items.zh: 我们公司五点半下班，我六点半才能到家。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī wǔ diǎn bàn xià bān wǒ liù diǎn bàn cái néng dào jiā
items.en: Our company finishes work at half past five, and I only get home at half past six.
items.why: 下班 means finish work for the day, the opposite of 上班. It is correct here, and 才 stresses that getting home is late.

items.q: 这个问题很复杂，我还没___清楚。
items.zh: 这个问题很复杂，我还没搞清楚。
items.py: zhè gè wèn tí hěn fù zá wǒ hái méi gǎo qīng chu
items.en: This problem is complicated and I haven't figured it out yet.
items.why: 搞清楚 is the casual spoken way to say "figure out". 做清楚 and 办清楚 are not combinations Chinese uses for understanding something.

items.q: 孩子每天放学回家，先___作业，然后才能玩。
items.zh: 孩子每天放学回家，先做作业，然后才能玩。
items.py: hái zi měi tiān fàng xué huí jiā xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu cái néng wán
items.en: Every day when the child comes home from school he does his homework first and only then can he play.
items.why: Homework is 做作业. 办作业 is a learner error: 办 is for formalities and errands, not for schoolwork.

items.q: 我们公司早上九点___班，下午六点下班。
items.zh: 我们公司早上九点上班，下午六点下班。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī zǎo shang jiǔ diǎn shàng bān xià wǔ liù diǎn xià bān
items.en: Our company starts work at nine in the morning and finishes at six in the afternoon.
items.why: Starting work is 上班, the opposite of 下班. 去班 and 来班 do not exist; you cannot go "to" 班, you start it.

items.s: 我每天早上七点去班，晚上六点回家。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qù bān wǎn shang liù diǎn huí jiā
items.zh: 我每天早上七点上班，晚上六点回家。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn shàng bān wǎn shang liù diǎn huí jiā
items.en: I start work at seven every morning and go home at six in the evening.
items.why: "Go to work" is 上班; you start a shift with 上. 去班 does not exist.

items.q: 铃声一响就___课了，同学们都跑去食堂吃饭。
items.zh: 铃声一响就下课了，同学们都跑去食堂吃饭。
items.py: líng shēng yī xiǎng jiù xià kè le tóng xué men dōu pǎo qù shí táng chī fàn
items.en: As soon as the bell rang, class was over and the students all ran off to the canteen to eat.
items.why: Finishing class is 下课. 上课 would mean the class begins, which makes no sense when they go off to eat, and 放课 does not exist.

items.q: 外面___着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
items.zh: 外面下着很大的雨，你带伞了吗？
items.py: wài miàn xià zhe hěn dà de yǔ nǐ dài sǎn le ma
items.en: It is raining hard outside; did you bring an umbrella?
items.why: Rain "comes down": 下雨, with no "it" and no 是. 有着很大的雨 and 是着很大的雨 are not Chinese.

items.s: 他在上课，等一下再给他打电话吧。
items.zh: 他在上课，等一下再给他打电话吧。
items.py: tā zài shàng kè děng yī xià zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà ba
items.en: He is in class; let us call him in a while.
items.why: 在上课 means he is in class right now, since 上课 covers both "class starts" and "be in class". 给他打电话 puts the person before 打.

items.q: 北京的冬天常常___雪，很冷。
items.zh: 北京的冬天常常下雪，很冷。
items.py: běi jīng de dōng tiān cháng cháng xià xuě hěn lěng
items.en: It often snows in Beijing in winter, and it is very cold.
items.why: Snow, like rain, takes 下: 下雪. 打雪 and 来雪 are not used for snowfall.

items.q: 我___了决心，从明天起每天早上去跑步。
items.zh: 我下了决心，从明天起每天早上去跑步。
items.py: wǒ xià le jué xīn cóng míng tiān qǐ měi tiān zǎo shang qù pǎo bù
items.en: I've made up my mind to go running every morning from tomorrow.
items.why: "Make up one's mind" is 下决心, a fixed phrase. 做决心 is the English-driven error, and 上决心 does not exist.

items.s: 我给你寄了一条短信，你收到了吗？
items.s_py: wǒ gěi nǐ jì le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ shōu dào le ma
items.zh: 我给你发了一条短信，你收到了吗？
items.py: wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ shōu dào le ma
items.en: I sent you a text message; did you get it?
items.why: 寄 is for things that physically travel by post. A text message is electronic, so it takes 发.

items.q: 办公室的电脑不能___网，我没法发邮件。
items.zh: 办公室的电脑不能上网，我没法发邮件。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de diàn nǎo bù néng shàng wǎng wǒ méi fǎ fā yóu jiàn
items.en: The computer in the office cannot get online, so I can't send email.
items.why: Going online is 上网. 下网 does not exist, and 进网 is not used for getting online.

items.q: 我妹妹今年十八岁，明年就要___大学了。
items.zh: 我妹妹今年十八岁，明年就要上大学了。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei jīn nián shí bā suì míng nián jiù yào shàng dà xué le
items.en: My younger sister is eighteen and will start university next year.
items.why: Entering university is 上大学. 下大学 is wrong: finishing university is 毕业, not 下大学.

items.q: 我昨天给经理___了一封邮件，他还没有回。
items.zh: 我昨天给经理发了一封邮件，他还没有回。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi jīng lǐ fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn tā hái méi yǒu huí
items.en: I sent the manager an email yesterday and he hasn't replied yet.
items.why: Email is sent with 发: 发邮件. 送 is for gifts and deliveries and 问 is for asking, so neither works with 邮件.

items.s: 我想去邮局给老家的朋友寄一封信。
items.zh: 我想去邮局给老家的朋友寄一封信。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng qù yóu jú gěi lǎo jiā de péng you jì yī fēng xìn
items.en: I want to go to the post office and send a letter to a friend back home.
items.why: A paper letter goes through the post, so 寄 is right. The person comes before the verb with 给.

items.q: 这个月的工资公司已经___了，你看看银行卡。
items.zh: 这个月的工资公司已经发了，你看看银行卡。
items.py: zhè gè yuè de gōng zī gōng sī yǐ jīng fā le nǐ kàn kan yín háng kǎ
items.en: The company has already paid this month's salary; check your bank card.
items.why: Paying wages is 发工资. 寄 is for things sent by post, and 提 is for raising a question or request, not paying anyone.

items.q: 我每个月都去邮局给住在农村的奶奶___一个包裹。
items.zh: 我每个月都去邮局给住在农村的奶奶寄一个包裹。
items.py: wǒ měi gè yuè dōu qù yóu jú gěi zhù zài nóng cūn de nǎi nai jì yī gè bāo guǒ
items.en: Every month I go to the post office and send a parcel to my grandma, who lives in the countryside.
items.why: A parcel sent through the post office is 寄. 打 and 提 do not mean posting something: 提 means to lift or raise, as in 提问题.

items.s: 老师提了一个问题，同学们都回答不出来。
items.zh: 老师提了一个问题，同学们都回答不出来。
items.py: lǎo shī tí le yī gè wèn tí tóng xué men dōu huí dá bù chū lái
items.en: The teacher asked a question and none of the students could answer it.
items.why: Here 问题 is a question: the teacher raises it with 提 and the students answer it with 回答. Both verbs fit a question.

items.q: 开会的时候，大家都对新办法___了很多意见。
items.zh: 开会的时候，大家都对新办法提了很多意见。
items.py: kāi huì de shí hou dà jiā dōu duì xīn bàn fǎ tí le hěn duō yì jiàn
items.en: At the meeting everyone made lots of comments on the new method.
items.why: Raising an opinion is 提意见. 寄 is only for things sent by post, and 打 is for calls, balls and injections.

items.q: 老师问了我一个问题，我马上___了。
items.zh: 老师问了我一个问题，我马上回答了。
items.py: lǎo shī wèn le wǒ yī gè wèn tí wǒ mǎ shàng huí dá le
items.en: The teacher asked me a question and I answered it right away.
items.why: A question put to you is answered: 回答. 解决 is for a problem that needs fixing, and 提 means raising a question, which the teacher just did.

items.s: 我每天早上起床以后先洗牙，再吃早饭。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān xǐ yá zài chī zǎo fàn
items.zh: 我每天早上起床以后先刷牙，再吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu xiān shuā yá zài chī zǎo fàn
items.en: Every morning after getting up I brush my teeth first and then have breakfast.
items.why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 exists but means a dentist's cleaning, so it does not fit a morning routine.

items.q: 电脑坏了，这个问题只有修理师傅才能___。
items.zh: 电脑坏了，这个问题只有修理师傅才能解决。
items.py: diàn nǎo huài le zhè gè wèn tí zhǐ yǒu xiū lǐ shī fu cái néng jiě jué
items.en: The computer is broken, and only the repairman can solve this problem.
items.why: Here 问题 is a problem to be fixed, so 解决. 回答 is for a question, and 提 would raise it rather than fix it.

items.q: 孩子昨天晚上___烧了，今天要去医院看看。
items.zh: 孩子昨天晚上发烧了，今天要去医院看看。
items.py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang fā shāo le jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn kàn kan
items.en: The child had a fever last night and today we are going to the hospital.
items.why: "Have a fever" is 发烧. 生烧 is not said, and 寄烧 makes no sense.

items.q: 我们在公园玩吧，我在花旁边给你___张照片。
items.zh: 我们在公园玩吧，我在花旁边给你拍张照片。
items.py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán wán ba wǒ zài huā páng biān gěi nǐ pāi zhāng zhào piàn
items.en: Let's play in the park, and I'll take a photo of you next to the flowers.
items.why: Taking a photo is 拍照片. 拿照片 means picking up a printed photo, and 打 does not go with 照片.

items.s: 今年春节，我们一家人去南方度假。
items.zh: 今年春节，我们一家人去南方度假。
items.py: jīn nián chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén qù nán fāng dù jià
items.en: This Spring Festival our whole family is going on holiday in the south.
items.why: 度假 is the verb for spending a holiday somewhere and takes no object, so 去南方度假 is a normal pattern.

items.q: 李老师的朋友是演员，现在在上海___电影。
items.zh: 李老师的朋友是演员，现在在上海拍电影。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī de péng you shì yǎn yuán xiàn zài zài shàng hǎi pāi diàn yǐng
items.en: Teacher Li's friend is an actor and is now filming a movie in Shanghai.
items.why: Films are shot with 拍: 拍电影. 照电影 is wrong because 照 is only for still photos, and 拿 means to hold or take.

items.q: 孩子每天晚上睡觉前都要___牙。
items.zh: 孩子每天晚上睡觉前都要刷牙。
items.py: hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào qián dōu yào shuā yá
items.en: The child has to brush his teeth every night before bed.
items.why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 is a cleaning at the dentist, not a bedtime routine, and 梳 is for hair.

items.s: 明天晚上我们去饭馆开生日吧。
items.s_py: míng tiān wǎn shang wǒ men qù fàn guǎn kāi shēng rì ba
items.zh: 明天晚上我们去饭馆过生日吧。
items.py: míng tiān wǎn shang wǒ men qù fàn guǎn guò shēng rì ba
items.en: Tomorrow evening let us go to a restaurant to celebrate the birthday.
items.why: A birthday is "passed": 过生日. 开 goes with 会, 灯 and 玩笑, not with 生日.

items.q: 她每天出门以前都要___头，把头发弄整齐。
items.zh: 她每天出门以前都要梳头，把头发弄整齐。
items.py: tā měi tiān chū mén yǐ qián dōu yào shū tóu bǎ tóu fa nòng zhěng qí
items.en: She combs her hair every day before leaving home so that it looks neat.
items.why: Hair is combed: 梳头. 刷头 is a learner error, and 拍头 means patting the head.

items.q: 今天是妈妈的生日，我们去饭馆给她___生日吧。
items.zh: 今天是妈妈的生日，我们去饭馆给她过生日吧。
items.py: jīn tiān shì mā ma de shēng rì wǒ men qù fàn guǎn gěi tā guò shēng rì ba
items.en: It is Mum's birthday today; let's go to a restaurant to celebrate it with her.
items.why: A birthday is "passed": 过生日. 开 goes with 会, 灯 and 玩笑, and 打 with balls and calls, so neither fits 生日.

items.s: 我每天早上七点取床。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǔ chuáng
items.zh: 我每天早上七点起床。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: I get up at seven every morning.
items.why: Getting up is 起床 (起 "rise"). 取 means collect or withdraw and cannot go with 床.

items.q: ___马路的时候，要看红绿灯。
items.zh: 过马路的时候，要看红绿灯。
items.py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou yào kàn hóng lǜ dēng
items.en: When you cross the road you must watch the traffic lights.
items.why: Crossing a road is 过马路. 开 is for driving or switching on, and 打 does not go with 马路.

items.q: 天气太热了，我一回家就想先___个澡。
items.zh: 天气太热了，我一回家就想先洗个澡。
items.py: tiān qì tài rè le wǒ yī huí jiā jiù xiǎng xiān xǐ gè zǎo
items.en: It is so hot that as soon as I get home I want to take a shower first.
items.why: Bathing is 洗澡. 刷 is for teeth and shoes, and 梳 is for hair, so neither fits 澡.

items.q: 明天早上有会，我得六点___床。
items.zh: 明天早上有会，我得六点起床。
items.py: míng tiān zǎo shang yǒu huì wǒ děi liù diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: I have a meeting tomorrow morning, so I have to get up at six.
items.why: Getting up is 起床. 取床 is a classic error: 取 means collect or withdraw. 站床 would mean standing on the bed.

items.s: 我去银行取了一千块钱。
items.zh: 我去银行取了一千块钱。
items.py: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ le yī qiān kuài qián
items.en: I went to the bank and withdrew a thousand yuan.
items.why: 取钱 is "withdraw money". 取 is the right verb for collecting what is yours, and it is different from 起 in 起床.

items.q: 我没带现金，得先去银行___钱。
items.zh: 我没带现金，得先去银行取钱。
items.py: wǒ méi dài xiàn jīn děi xiān qù yín háng qǔ qián
items.en: I have no cash on me, so I have to go to the bank and take out some money first.
items.why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 存 would be depositing, which is the opposite of what someone without cash needs, and 起钱 is a learner error.

items.q: 他每天都玩游戏，不做作业，妈妈很___气。
items.zh: 他每天都玩游戏，不做作业，妈妈很生气。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu wán yóu xì bù zuò zuò yè mā ma hěn shēng qì
items.en: He plays games every day and does not do his homework, so his mum is very angry.
items.why: Getting angry is 生气. 起气 and 发气 are not words for being angry.

items.s: 她生了孩子以后，就没有再上班了。
items.zh: 她生了孩子以后，就没有再上班了。
items.py: tā shēng le hái zi yǐ hòu jiù méi yǒu zài shàng bān le
items.en: After she had the baby she did not go back to work.
items.why: 生孩子 "give birth" is the normal phrase, with 生 meaning produce. 没有再…了 says she no longer works.

items.q: 他昨天淋了雨，晚上就___病了，今天没来上班。
items.zh: 他昨天淋了雨，晚上就生病了，今天没来上班。
items.py: tā zuó tiān lín le yǔ wǎn shang jiù shēng bìng le jīn tiān méi lái shàng bān
items.en: He got caught in the rain yesterday, fell ill at night and did not come to work today.
items.why: Falling ill is 生病. 取 means collect or withdraw and 留 means leave behind, so neither can take 病.

items.q: 老师今天给我们___了很多作业，周末都没时间玩了。
items.zh: 老师今天给我们留了很多作业，周末都没时间玩了。
items.py: lǎo shī jīn tiān gěi wǒ men liú le hěn duō zuò yè zhōu mò dōu méi shí jiān wán le
items.en: The teacher set us a lot of homework today, so there is no time to play at the weekend.
items.why: Setting homework is 留作业 ("leave" it for them). 取 means to collect, and 生 is for producing a baby or an emotion.

items.s: 这杯茶太强了，我喝不下去。
items.s_py: zhè bēi chá tài qiáng le wǒ hē bú xià qù
items.zh: 这杯茶太浓了，我喝不下去。
items.py: zhè bēi chá tài nóng le wǒ hē bú xià qù
items.en: This tea is too strong; I can't drink it.
items.why: Strong tea is 浓 (thick, concentrated). 强 means strong in power or ability and is never used for a drink.

items.q: 我打算明年去英国___学，学习英语。
items.zh: 我打算明年去英国留学，学习英语。
items.py: wǒ dǎ suàn míng nián qù yīng guó liú xué xué xí yīng yǔ
items.en: I plan to go to Britain next year to study abroad and learn English.
items.why: Studying abroad is 去 + country + 留学. 生学 and 起学 are not words.

items.q: 晚上喝太___的茶会睡不着觉。
items.zh: 晚上喝太浓的茶会睡不着觉。
items.py: wǎn shang hē tài nóng de chá huì shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: If you drink very strong tea in the evening you won't be able to sleep.
items.why: Strong tea is 浓茶 (thick, concentrated). 强 describes power or ability, and 重 describes weight or serious illness.

items.q: 这家饭馆的咖啡太___了，像水一样，没有味道。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的咖啡太淡了，像水一样，没有味道。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de kā fēi tài dàn le xiàng shuǐ yī yàng méi yǒu wèi dào
items.en: The coffee at this restaurant is too weak; it is like water and has no flavour.
items.why: Weak coffee or tea is 淡 (the opposite of 浓). 轻 is for light weight, and 浅 is for colours and shallow things.

items.s: 这场雨下得很大，路上的车都开得很慢。
items.zh: 这场雨下得很大，路上的车都开得很慢。
items.py: zhè chǎng yǔ xià de hěn dà lù shàng de chē dōu kāi de hěn màn
items.en: The rain is heavy, and all the cars on the road are driving slowly.
items.why: Rain is big or small, 大 or 小, not "heavy". 雨下得很大 is the normal way to say it is raining hard.

items.q: 外面雨下得很___，我们等雨小一点儿再走吧。
items.zh: 外面雨下得很大，我们等雨小一点儿再走吧。
items.py: wài miàn yǔ xià de hěn dà wǒ men děng yǔ xiǎo yī diǎn r zài zǒu ba
items.en: It is raining hard outside; let us wait until the rain eases before leaving.
items.why: Rain is 大 or 小, as the second clause 雨小一点儿 confirms. 雨下得很重 and 雨很强 are translations from English.

items.q: 他的病很___，医生说要住院一个月。
items.zh: 他的病很重，医生说要住院一个月。
items.py: tā de bìng hěn zhòng yī shēng shuō yào zhù yuàn yī gè yuè
items.en: His illness is serious; the doctor says he needs to stay in hospital for a month.
items.why: A serious illness is 重 (heavy). 大 is for rain, wind and sound, and 深 is for colours and impressions.

items.s: 昨天下了一场重雨，路上到处都是水。
items.s_py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng zhòng yǔ lù shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ
items.zh: 昨天下了一场大雨，路上到处都是水。
items.py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ lù shàng dào chù dōu shì shuǐ
items.en: There was a heavy rainfall yesterday and there is water everywhere on the roads.
items.why: Heavy rain is 大雨. 重 is for weight and serious illness, so 重雨 is a word-for-word translation from English.

items.q: 这件衬衫的颜色太___了，我想换一件深一点儿的。
items.zh: 这件衬衫的颜色太浅了，我想换一件深一点儿的。
items.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān de yán sè tài qiǎn le wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn shēn yī diǎn r de
items.en: The colour of this shirt is too light; I want to swap it for a darker one.
items.why: Light and dark colours are 浅 and 深, and the contrast 深一点儿 points to 浅. 轻 is for weight, and 小 is for size.

items.q: 这家饭馆的服务给我留下了很___的印象。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的服务给我留下了很深的印象。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de fú wù gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng
items.en: The service at this restaurant left a deep impression on me.
items.why: An impression is 深 (deep). 重 is for weight or illness, and 浓 is for tea and smells, not for impressions.

items.s: 我不喜欢太淡的茶，喜欢浓一点儿的。
items.zh: 我不喜欢太淡的茶，喜欢浓一点儿的。
items.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài dàn de chá xǐ huan nóng yī diǎn r de
items.en: I do not like tea that is too weak; I prefer it a bit stronger.
items.why: 淡 and 浓 are the pair for weak and strong tea. 浓一点儿的 uses 的 to stand for 茶.

items.q: 房间里太吵了，请把电视的声音开___一点儿。
items.zh: 房间里太吵了，请把电视的声音开小一点儿。
items.py: fáng jiān lǐ tài chǎo le qǐng bǎ diàn shì de shēng yīn kāi xiǎo yī diǎn r
items.en: It is too noisy in the room; please turn the TV down a bit.
items.why: Volume is 大 or 小, so lowering it is 开小. 重 is for weight or serious illness and 少 is for quantity, not for sound.

items.q: 爷爷看报纸的时候要___老花镜。
items.zh: 爷爷看报纸的时候要戴老花镜。
items.py: yé ye kàn bào zhǐ de shí hou yào dài lǎo huā jìng
items.en: Grandpa has to wear his reading glasses when he reads the newspaper.
items.why: Glasses are put on the face, so 戴. 穿 is only for clothes and shoes, and 系 is for things you tie.

items.s: 我们周末骑地铁去市中心。
items.s_py: wǒ men zhōu mò qí dì tiě qù shì zhōng xīn
items.zh: 我们周末坐地铁去市中心。
items.py: wǒ men zhōu mò zuò dì tiě qù shì zhōng xīn
items.en: At the weekend we take the subway into the city centre.
items.why: Passengers sit inside a subway, so 坐. 骑 is only for things you straddle, such as bikes and horses.

items.q: 下雨了，别骑自行车了，我们___地铁去吧。
items.zh: 下雨了，别骑自行车了，我们坐地铁去吧。
items.py: xià yǔ le bié qí zì xíng chē le wǒ men zuò dì tiě qù ba
items.en: It's raining, so let's not cycle; let's take the subway.
items.why: Passengers take a subway with 坐. 骑 is for bikes and horses, 开 is for the driver, and 打 does not go with 地铁.

items.q: 今天是爷爷七十岁的生日，全家人都来给他___生日。
items.zh: 今天是爷爷七十岁的生日，全家人都来给他过生日。
items.py: jīn tiān shì yé ye qī shí suì de shēng rì quán jiā rén dōu lái gěi tā guò shēng rì
items.en: Today is Grandpa's seventieth birthday and the whole family came to celebrate with him.
items.why: A birthday is 'passed': 过生日. 开 and 打 do not combine with 生日.

items.q: 今年冬天特别冷，上个星期___了一场大雪。
items.zh: 今年冬天特别冷，上个星期下了一场大雪。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān tè bié lěng shàng gè xīng qī xià le yī chǎng dà xuě
items.en: This winter is especially cold; last week there was a heavy snowfall.
items.why: A snowfall is 下雪, counted with 一场. 打 and 发 do not combine with 雪.

items.s: 弟弟每天晚上都读电视到很晚。
items.s_py: dì di měi tiān wǎn shang dōu dú diàn shì dào hěn wǎn
items.zh: 弟弟每天晚上都看电视到很晚。
items.py: dì di měi tiān wǎn shang dōu kàn diàn shì dào hěn wǎn
items.en: My younger brother watches TV until late every evening.
items.why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 is for reading text.

items.q: 孩子们在海边___了很多照片，笑得很开心。
items.zh: 孩子们在海边拍了很多照片，笑得很开心。
items.py: hái zi men zài hǎi biān pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn xiào de hěn kāi xīn
items.en: The children took lots of photos at the seaside and laughed happily.
items.why: Photos are taken with 拍 (or 照). English 'take' does not carry over: 拿 means to pick up or hold, and 做 and 打 do not fit 照片.

items.q: 奶奶年轻的时候会___钢琴，现在手指不灵活了。
items.zh: 奶奶年轻的时候会弹钢琴，现在手指不灵活了。
items.py: nǎi nai nián qīng de shí hou huì tán gāng qín xiàn zài shǒu zhǐ bù líng huó le
items.en: Grandma could play the piano when she was young, but her fingers are stiff now.
items.why: Piano keys are pressed, so it is 弹钢琴. 打钢琴 is a slip from English 'play'; 拉 is only for the violin and 吹 for wind instruments.

items.q: 外面雨很大，你出门记得___伞。
items.zh: 外面雨很大，你出门记得打伞。
items.py: wài miàn yǔ hěn dà nǐ chū mén jì de dǎ sǎn
items.en: It's raining hard outside; remember to put up an umbrella when you go out.
items.why: An umbrella is held up with 打: 打伞. 穿 is for clothes, 戴 for hats and glasses, and 系 for things you tie, so none of them fits 伞.

items.q: 我把时间___错了，所以今天迟到了二十分钟。
items.zh: 我把时间搞错了，所以今天迟到了二十分钟。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shí jiān gǎo cuò le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān chí dào le èr shí fēn zhōng
items.en: I got the time wrong, so I was twenty minutes late today.
items.why: 搞错 is the casual spoken 'get it wrong, mess up'. 办 is for formalities, and 发 and 开 do not make 'get the time wrong'.

items.q: 爸爸和爷爷在客厅里___棋，我在旁边看。
items.zh: 爸爸和爷爷在客厅里下棋，我在旁边看。
items.py: bà ba hé yé ye zài kè tīng lǐ xià qí wǒ zài páng biān kàn
items.en: Dad and Grandpa are playing chess in the living room while I watch.
items.why: Chess pieces are put down, so the verb is 下: 下棋. 打 does not go with 棋, and 弹 and 拉 are for instruments.

items.q: 外面___雪了，明天可以和孩子们堆雪人了。
items.zh: 外面下雪了，明天可以和孩子们堆雪人了。
items.py: wài miàn xià xuě le míng tiān kě yǐ hé hái zi men duī xuě rén le
items.en: It's snowing outside; tomorrow we can build a snowman with the kids.
items.why: Snow and rain 'come down', so 下雪. 雪 is a noun, so 是 or 在 directly before it is wrong, and there is no 'it' subject in Chinese weather.

items.q: 周末妈妈在厨房里___饭，我在旁边帮忙。
items.zh: 周末妈妈在厨房里做饭，我在旁边帮忙。
items.py: zhōu mò mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ zuò fàn wǒ zài páng biān bāng máng
items.en: At weekends Mum cooks in the kitchen and I help.
items.why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 发 is for sending.

items.s: 孩子每天晚上洗牙，所以牙齿很白。
items.s_py: hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang xǐ yá suǒ yǐ yá chǐ hěn bái
items.zh: 孩子每天晚上刷牙，所以牙齿很白。
items.py: hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang shuā yá suǒ yǐ yá chǐ hěn bái
items.en: The child brushes his teeth every night, so his teeth are very white.
items.why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 is a professional cleaning at the dentist's.

items.q: 他昨天淋了雨，今天就___病了。
items.zh: 他昨天淋了雨，今天就生病了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān lín le yǔ jīn tiān jiù shēng bìng le
items.en: He got soaked in the rain yesterday and is ill today.
items.why: Falling ill is 生病. 起 and 留 do not take 病, and 取 is for withdrawing or collecting.

items.q: 电脑坏了，我们一起想办法把这个问题___吧。
items.zh: 电脑坏了，我们一起想办法把这个问题解决吧。
items.py: diàn nǎo huài le wǒ men yī qǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ bǎ zhè ge wèn tí jiě jué ba
items.en: The computer is broken; let's find a way to solve this problem together.
items.why: A problem that must be fixed is 解决. 想办法 shows it is a problem to solve, not a question to answer (回答) or raise (提).

items.s: 去中国留学以前，他先去办了签证。
items.s_py: qù zhōng guó liú xué yǐ qián tā xiān qù bàn le qiān zhèng
items.zh: 去中国留学以前，他先去办了签证。
items.py: qù zhōng guó liú xué yǐ qián tā xiān qù bàn le qiān zhèng
items.en: Before going to study in China, he first went to get a visa.
items.why: Visas are official formalities, so 办签证 is the standard phrase. 办 is right here even though English says 'get'.

items.s: 爸爸身体不好，已经不喝烟了。
items.s_py: bà ba shēn tǐ bù hǎo yǐ jīng bù hē yān le
items.zh: 爸爸身体不好，已经不抽烟了。
items.py: bà ba shēn tǐ bù hǎo yǐ jīng bù chōu yān le
items.en: Dad's health isn't good, so he has stopped smoking.
items.why: Cigarettes are smoked, so 抽烟. 喝 is for drinks and soup.

items.q: 国庆节我们去草原___马，玩得很开心。
items.zh: 国庆节我们去草原骑马，玩得很开心。
items.py: guó qìng jié wǒ men qù cǎo yuán qí mǎ wán de hěn kāi xīn
items.en: On National Day we went riding on the grassland and had a great time.
items.why: You sit astride a horse, so 骑马. 坐 and 乘 are for passengers in vehicles, and 开 is for a driver.

items.s: 今年夏天我们打算去海边度假。
items.s_py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān dù jià
items.zh: 今年夏天我们打算去海边度假。
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān dù jià
items.en: This summer we plan to go on holiday to the seaside.
items.why: 度假 is the fixed word for spending a holiday away. The verb is 度, so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 每天晚上睡觉以前，我都要___牙。
items.zh: 每天晚上睡觉以前，我都要刷牙。
items.py: měi tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào yǐ qián wǒ dōu yào shuā yá
items.en: I brush my teeth every night before bed.
items.why: Teeth are brushed with 刷. 洗牙 is a cleaning at the dentist, not daily brushing, and 梳 is for hair.

items.q: 暑假我们打算___飞机去上海看奶奶。
items.zh: 暑假我们打算坐飞机去上海看奶奶。
items.py: shǔ jià wǒ men dǎ suàn zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi kàn nǎi nai
items.en: In the summer holiday we plan to fly to Shanghai to see Grandma.
items.why: A passenger 坐s a plane. 开飞机 would mean piloting it, and 骑 is only for bikes and horses that you sit astride.

items.q: 晚上八点，爸爸喜欢坐在沙发上___电视。
items.zh: 晚上八点，爸爸喜欢坐在沙发上看电视。
items.py: wǎn shang bā diǎn bà ba xǐ huan zuò zài shā fā shang kàn diàn shì
items.en: At eight in the evening Dad likes to sit on the sofa and watch TV.
items.why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 and 念 are for reading text, and 听 is for sounds, not pictures.

items.q: 你别生气，我只是跟你___玩笑。
items.zh: 你别生气，我只是跟你开玩笑。
items.py: nǐ bié shēng qì wǒ zhǐ shì gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào
items.en: Don't be angry; I was only kidding.
items.why: 开玩笑 is the fixed phrase for kidding or teasing. 讲 and 说 go with 笑话 'a joke', not with 玩笑.

items.q: 他___了决心，明年一定要考上大学。
items.zh: 他下了决心，明年一定要考上大学。
items.py: tā xià le jué xīn míng nián yī dìng yào kǎo shàng dà xué
items.en: He made up his mind to get into university next year.
items.why: 下决心 is the fixed phrase for making up one's mind. 做 and 打 do not combine with 决心 (做决定 is a different phrase).

items.q: 我头疼好几天了，下午要去医院___病。
items.zh: 我头疼好几天了，下午要去医院看病。
items.py: wǒ tóu téng hǎo jǐ tiān le xià wǔ yào qù yī yuàn kàn bìng
items.en: I've had a headache for days, so this afternoon I'm going to the hospital to see a doctor.
items.why: Going to a doctor is 看病. 吃 is for taking medicine, 读 is for reading aloud or studying, and 做 does not fit 病.

items.s: 这双鞋是新的，我今天第一次戴。
items.s_py: zhè shuāng xié shì xīn de wǒ jīn tiān dì yī cì dài
items.zh: 这双鞋是新的，我今天第一次穿。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié shì xīn de wǒ jīn tiān dì yī cì chuān
items.en: These shoes are new; today is the first time I'm wearing them.
items.why: Shoes are things you get into, so 穿. 戴 is for hats, glasses, watches and masks.

items.q: 我家离学校很近，我每天___自行车去上课。
items.zh: 我家离学校很近，我每天骑自行车去上课。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn wǒ měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù shàng kè
items.en: My home is close to school, so I ride my bike to class every day.
items.why: You sit astride a bike, so 骑. 开 is for vehicles you drive from a seat, such as cars and buses.

items.q: 公司下午三点要___会，大家别迟到。
items.zh: 公司下午三点要开会，大家别迟到。
items.py: gōng sī xià wǔ sān diǎn yào kāi huì dà jiā bié chí dào
items.en: The company has a meeting at three this afternoon; don't be late.
items.why: A meeting is held with 开: 开会. 做 and 打 do not combine with 会, and 看 is for looking.

items.q: 小弟弟发烧了，医生给他___了一针。
items.zh: 小弟弟发烧了，医生给他打了一针。
items.py: xiǎo dì di fā shāo le yī shēng gěi tā dǎ le yī zhēn
items.en: Little brother had a fever, so the doctor gave him an injection.
items.why: An injection is 打针, the same verb for giving and having one. 发 goes with 烧 and 邮件, 吃 with pills, and 看 with seeing a doctor.

items.q: 周末不上班，我们都九点才___床。
items.zh: 周末不上班，我们都九点才起床。
items.py: zhōu mò bù shàng bān wǒ men dōu jiǔ diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
items.en: We don't work at weekends, so we don't get up until nine.
items.why: Getting out of bed is 起床. 站 is for standing up, 上床 means to get into bed, and 取 is for collecting.

items.q: 天气冷了，妈妈给孩子___了一件厚毛衣。
items.zh: 天气冷了，妈妈给孩子穿了一件厚毛衣。
items.py: tiān qì lěng le mā ma gěi hái zi chuān le yī jiàn hòu máo yī
items.en: It has turned cold, so Mum put a thick sweater on the child.
items.why: A sweater is something you get into, so 穿. 戴 is for hats, glasses and watches, 系 for ties and belts, and 打 does not take clothes.

items.s: 奶奶看书的时候穿着眼镜。
items.s_py: nǎi nai kàn shū de shí hou chuān zhe yǎn jìng
items.zh: 奶奶看书的时候戴着眼镜。
items.py: nǎi nai kàn shū de shí hou dài zhe yǎn jìng
items.en: Grandma wears glasses when she reads.
items.why: Glasses are put on, so 戴. 穿 is only for clothes and shoes.

items.q: 这件衣服颜色太___了，我想换一件浅一点儿的。
items.zh: 这件衣服颜色太深了，我想换一件浅一点儿的。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu yán sè tài shēn le wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn qiǎn yī diǎn r de
items.en: The colour of this garment is too dark; I'd like to swap it for a lighter one.
items.why: Dark colours are 深 and light ones 浅, and 浅 later in the sentence confirms the pair. 大, 高 and 强 do not describe colour.

items.q: 我昨天给你___了一封邮件，你收到了吗？
items.zh: 我昨天给你发了一封邮件，你收到了吗？
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi nǐ fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn nǐ shōu dào le ma
items.en: I sent you an email yesterday. Did you get it?
items.why: Electronic mail is sent with 发. 送 is for gifts and deliveries, and 提 and 问 are for questions.

items.q: 我晚上常常___网跟朋友聊天。
items.zh: 我晚上常常上网跟朋友聊天。
items.py: wǒ wǎn shang cháng cháng shàng wǎng gēn péng you liáo tiān
items.en: In the evening I often go online to chat with friends.
items.why: Going online is 上网. 下 means to leave or finish, and 打 and 开 do not combine with 网.

items.s: 老师，我可以问你一个问题吗？
items.s_py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí ma
items.zh: 老师，我可以问你一个问题吗？
items.py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí ma
items.en: Teacher, may I ask you a question?
items.why: Asking a person is 问 + person + 问题, a perfectly normal pattern. 提问题 is also possible, but 问 is not wrong.

items.s: 我刚才给你寄了一条短信，你看到了吗？
items.s_py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ jì le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
items.zh: 我刚才给你发了一条短信，你看到了吗？
items.py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
items.en: I just sent you a text message; did you see it?
items.why: Texts are electronic, so 发. 寄 is only for things that go through the post.

items.q: 她每天早上都花十分钟___头发。
items.zh: 她每天早上都花十分钟梳头发。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang dōu huā shí fēn zhōng shū tóu fa
items.en: She spends ten minutes combing her hair every morning.
items.why: Hair is combed with 梳. 刷 is for teeth and shoes, and 穿 and 戴 are for clothes and accessories.

items.q: 爷爷喜欢喝很___的茶，所以晚上常常睡不着。
items.zh: 爷爷喜欢喝很浓的茶，所以晚上常常睡不着。
items.py: yé ye xǐ huan hē hěn nóng de chá suǒ yǐ wǎn shang cháng cháng shuì bù zháo
items.en: Grandpa likes very strong tea, so he often can't sleep at night.
items.why: Tea that is strong in taste is 浓. 强 describes power or ability, never a drink, and 重 and 深 do not describe tea.

items.q: 孩子昨天晚上突然___烧了，三十九度，我们马上去了医院。
items.zh: 孩子昨天晚上突然发烧了，三十九度，我们马上去了医院。
items.py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang tū rán fā shāo le sān shí jiǔ dù wǒ men mǎ shàng qù le yī yuàn
items.en: The child suddenly ran a fever last night, thirty-nine degrees, so we went to the hospital straight away.
items.why: A fever is 发烧. 生烧 is not a word, though 生病 is, and 起 and 送 do not fit 烧.

items.q: 我昨天晚上___了一个很长的梦，梦见了小时候的家。
items.zh: 我昨天晚上做了一个很长的梦，梦见了小时候的家。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zuò le yī gè hěn cháng de mèng mèng jiàn le xiǎo shí hou de jiā
items.en: Last night I had a very long dream; I dreamed of my childhood home.
items.why: A dream is 'made' in Chinese: 做梦. English 'have a dream' does not carry over, and 看, 说 and 睡 do not take 梦 this way.

items.q: 今天空气不好，出门别忘了___口罩。
items.zh: 今天空气不好，出门别忘了戴口罩。
items.py: jīn tiān kōng qì bù hǎo chū mén bié wàng le dài kǒu zhào
items.en: The air is bad today; don't forget to wear a mask when you go out.
items.why: Masks, hats and glasses are put on, so 戴. 穿 is for clothes and shoes, and 系 is for ties and belts.

items.q: 我身上没有现金了，得去银行___钱。
items.zh: 我身上没有现金了，得去银行取钱。
items.py: wǒ shēn shang méi yǒu xiàn jīn le děi qù yín háng qǔ qián
items.en: I have no cash on me; I have to go to the bank to take out some money.
items.why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 起 is for getting up and giving names, 留 is for leaving, and 生 is for giving birth or falling ill.

items.q: 这杯咖啡太___了，我喝不习惯，请再加点儿水。
items.zh: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我喝不习惯，请再加点儿水。
items.py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le wǒ hē bù xí guàn qǐng zài jiā diǎn r shuǐ
items.en: This coffee is too strong for me; please add a little more water.
items.why: Strong coffee is 浓, and asking for more water shows it needs diluting. 淡 means weak and would not need water; 强 and 深 do not describe a drink.

items.s: 今天是星期天，所以我不用上班。
items.s_py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī tiān suǒ yǐ wǒ bù yòng shàng bān
items.zh: 今天是星期天，所以我不用上班。
items.py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī tiān suǒ yǐ wǒ bù yòng shàng bān
items.en: It's Sunday, so I don't have to go to work.
items.why: 上班 is the fixed phrase for going to work and is simply negated with 不用. Nothing needs 去 or 到.

items.s: 妹妹从五岁开始拉小提琴，现在拉得很好。
items.s_py: mèi mei cóng wǔ suì kāi shǐ lā xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài lā de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 妹妹从五岁开始拉小提琴，现在拉得很好。
items.py: mèi mei cóng wǔ suì kāi shǐ lā xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài lā de hěn hǎo
items.en: My younger sister has played the violin since she was five and plays very well now.
items.why: The violin is bowed, so 拉小提琴 is right. 弹小提琴 would be the wrong verb.

items.q: 同学们约好星期六下午去学校操场___篮球，然后一起去吃饭。
items.zh: 同学们约好星期六下午去学校操场打篮球，然后一起去吃饭。
items.py: tóng xué men yuē hǎo xīng qī liù xià wǔ qù xué xiào cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú rán hòu yī qǐ qù chī fàn
items.en: The classmates agreed to play basketball on the school field on Saturday afternoon and then eat together.
items.why: Basketball is played with the hands, so it takes 打, not 踢. 弹 and 下 belong to instruments and chess.

items.s: 他的病很大，已经住院两个星期了。
items.s_py: tā de bìng hěn dà yǐ jīng zhù yuàn liǎng gè xīng qī le
items.zh: 他的病很重，已经住院两个星期了。
items.py: tā de bìng hěn zhòng yǐ jīng zhù yuàn liǎng gè xīng qī le
items.en: He is seriously ill and has been in hospital for two weeks.
items.why: A serious illness is 重. 大 is the English 'big' and does not describe illness.

items.q: 姐姐每天晚上在房间里___小提琴，声音很好听。
items.zh: 姐姐每天晚上在房间里拉小提琴，声音很好听。
items.py: jiě jie měi tiān wǎn shang zài fáng jiān lǐ lā xiǎo tí qín shēng yīn hěn hǎo tīng
items.en: My older sister plays the violin in her room every evening; it sounds lovely.
items.why: The violin is bowed, so it takes 拉. 弹 is for piano and guitar, 吹 for wind instruments, and 打 for ball games.

items.q: 暑假我们去海边___了一个星期的假。
items.zh: 暑假我们去海边度了一个星期的假。
items.py: shǔ jià wǒ men qù hǎi biān dù le yī gè xīng qī de jià
items.en: In the summer holiday we spent a week's holiday at the seaside.
items.why: 度假 is 'spend a holiday'. 打, 发 and 开 do not combine with 假.

items.q: 爷爷以前每天要___一包烟，现在为了健康，一根也不碰了。
items.zh: 爷爷以前每天要抽一包烟，现在为了健康，一根也不碰了。
items.py: yé ye yǐ qián měi tiān yào chōu yī bāo yān xiàn zài wèi le jiàn kāng yī gēn yě bù pèng le
items.en: Grandpa used to smoke a pack a day, but for his health he doesn't touch a single one now.
items.why: Cigarettes are smoked with 抽: 抽烟. 喝烟 is a slip from drinking verbs, and 看 and 读 are for the eyes.

items.q: 上课的时候，你有不明白的地方可以随时向老师___问题。
items.zh: 上课的时候，你有不明白的地方可以随时向老师提问题。
items.py: shàng kè de shí hou nǐ yǒu bù míng bai de dì fang kě yǐ suí shí xiàng lǎo shī tí wèn tí
items.en: In class, if there's something you don't understand you can raise a question with the teacher at any time.
items.why: Raising a question is 提问题. 回答 is for answering one and 解决 is for solving a problem.

items.q: 我的朋友打算明年去英国___学。
items.zh: 我的朋友打算明年去英国留学。
items.py: wǒ de péng you dǎ suàn míng nián qù yīng guó liú xué
items.en: My friend plans to study in Britain next year.
items.why: Studying abroad is 留学. 读 takes 大学 or 书 but does not form a word with 学, and 取 does not fit.

items.q: 我弟弟每个周末都去公园___足球。
items.zh: 我弟弟每个周末都去公园踢足球。
items.py: wǒ dì di měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù gōng yuán tī zú qiú
items.en: My younger brother goes to the park to play football every weekend.
items.why: Football is kicked, so it takes 踢. 打 is for hand or racket ball games such as 篮球 and 网球; 弹 is for keys and strings, and 下 is for chess.

items.q: 这部电影是一位年轻的导演___的，花了整整两年才完成。
items.zh: 这部电影是一位年轻的导演拍的，花了整整两年才完成。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì yī wèi nián qīng de dǎo yǎn pāi de huā le zhěng zhěng liǎng nián cái wán chéng
items.en: This film was shot by a young director and took a full two years to finish.
items.why: Films are shot with 拍. 照电影 is a slip from English 'shoot', and 拿 and 打 do not fit 电影.

items.q: 明天放假，可是老师还是给我们___了两页作业。
items.zh: 明天放假，可是老师还是给我们留了两页作业。
items.py: míng tiān fàng jià kě shì lǎo shī hái shi gěi wǒ men liú le liǎng yè zuò yè
items.en: Tomorrow is a holiday, but the teacher still set us two pages of homework.
items.why: Setting homework is 留作业: the teacher 'leaves' it for you. 送 is for gifts, 提 is for raising points, and 取 is for collecting.

items.s: 我哥哥喜欢打足球，每个周末都去。
items.s_py: wǒ gē ge xǐ huan dǎ zú qiú měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù
items.zh: 我哥哥喜欢踢足球，每个周末都去。
items.py: wǒ gē ge xǐ huan tī zú qiú měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù
items.en: My older brother likes playing football and goes every weekend.
items.why: Football is kicked, so it is 踢足球. 打 is for hand and racket ball games such as 篮球.

items.q: 公司每个月十号给我们___工资。
items.zh: 公司每个月十号给我们发工资。
items.py: gōng sī měi gè yuè shí hào gěi wǒ men fā gōng zī
items.en: The company pays us on the tenth of every month.
items.why: Paying wages is 发工资. 寄 is only for things that go through the post, and 送 is for gifts.

items.s: 昨天晚上我办了一个很奇怪的梦。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ bàn le yī gè hěn qí guài de mèng
items.zh: 昨天晚上我做了一个很奇怪的梦。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ zuò le yī gè hěn qí guài de mèng
items.en: Last night I had a very strange dream.
items.why: A dream is 'made': 做梦. 办 is for formalities and errands.

items.q: 奶奶的病很___，医生说要住院一个月。
items.zh: 奶奶的病很重，医生说要住院一个月。
items.py: nǎi nai de bìng hěn zhòng yī shēng shuō yào zhù yuàn yī gè yuè
items.en: Grandma is seriously ill; the doctor says she must stay in hospital for a month.
items.why: A serious illness is 重 (a mild one is 轻). 大 is the tempting 'big', but 病 does not take it as a predicate.

items.s: 爸爸妈妈给小宝宝起了一个很好听的名字。
items.s_py: bà ba mā ma gěi xiǎo bǎo bao qǐ le yī gè hěn hǎo tīng de míng zi
items.zh: 爸爸妈妈给小宝宝起了一个很好听的名字。
items.py: bà ba mā ma gěi xiǎo bǎo bao qǐ le yī gè hěn hǎo tīng de míng zi
items.en: Mum and Dad gave the baby a lovely name.
items.why: 起名字 is the normal phrase for naming someone (取名字 works too). 起 here is not 'rise', so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 开车的时候一定要___好安全带。
items.zh: 开车的时候一定要系好安全带。
items.py: kāi chē de shí hou yī dìng yào jì hǎo ān quán dài
items.en: You must fasten your seat belt when you drive.
items.why: A seat belt is fastened like a tie, with 系 (read jì). 穿 is for clothes, and 戴 and 打 are not used with 安全带.

items.s: 参加面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
items.s_py: cān jiā miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
items.zh: 参加面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
items.py: cān jiā miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
items.en: He wore a blue tie to the job interview.
items.why: A tie is tied, so 系 (jì) is right. 穿领带 would be wrong, because 穿 is for clothes you get into.

items.s: 我每天晚上八点以后才办作业。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu cái bàn zuò yè
items.zh: 我每天晚上八点以后才做作业。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu cái zuò zuò yè
items.en: I don't do my homework until after eight every evening.
items.why: Homework is done with 做. 办 is for formalities and errands, like 办手续.

items.q: 外面下雪了，你要___上帽子和手套，别把耳朵冻坏了。
items.zh: 外面下雪了，你要戴上帽子和手套，别把耳朵冻坏了。
items.py: wài miàn xià xuě le nǐ yào dài shàng mào zi hé shǒu tào bié bǎ ěr duo dòng huài le
items.en: It's snowing outside; put on a hat and gloves so your ears don't freeze.
items.why: Hats and gloves are put on, so 戴. 穿 is for things you get into, like coats and boots, and 系 is for things you tie.

items.s: 弟弟每天九点钟去班，六点才回家。
items.s_py: dì di měi tiān jiǔ diǎn zhōng qù bān liù diǎn cái huí jiā
items.zh: 弟弟每天九点钟上班，六点才回家。
items.py: dì di měi tiān jiǔ diǎn zhōng shàng bān liù diǎn cái huí jiā
items.en: My younger brother starts work at nine every day and only gets home at six.
items.why: Going to work is 上班; 班 on its own is a shift or a class, so 去班 is not a phrase.

items.q: 她手腕上___着一块很漂亮的手表。
items.zh: 她手腕上戴着一块很漂亮的手表。
items.py: tā shǒu wàn shang dài zhe yī kuài hěn piào liang de shǒu biǎo
items.en: She has a very pretty watch on her wrist.
items.why: A watch is worn, so 戴. 穿 is for clothes, and 拿着 would mean she is holding it in her hand, which 手腕上 'on the wrist' rules out.

items.s: 我去银行起钱，顺便把信寄了。
items.s_py: wǒ qù yín háng qǐ qián shùn biàn bǎ xìn jì le
items.zh: 我去银行取钱，顺便把信寄了。
items.py: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián shùn biàn bǎ xìn jì le
items.en: I went to the bank to withdraw some money and posted a letter on the way.
items.why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 起 is for getting up and naming.

items.s: 外面下着大雨，我们打车去朋友家吧。
items.s_py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ men dǎ chē qù péng you jiā ba
items.zh: 外面下着大雨，我们打车去朋友家吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ men dǎ chē qù péng you jiā ba
items.en: It's pouring outside; let's take a taxi to my friend's place.
items.why: 打车 is the normal way to say 'take a taxi' (hail one). 打 has nothing to do with hitting here, so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 弟弟打碎了杯子，妈妈很___气，说了他几句。
items.zh: 弟弟打碎了杯子，妈妈很生气，说了他几句。
items.py: dì di dǎ suì le bēi zi mā ma hěn shēng qì shuō le tā jǐ jù
items.en: My little brother broke a glass, and Mum was angry and scolded him.
items.why: Getting angry is 生气. 起, 留 and 取 do not combine with 气.

items.q: 邻居敲门，给我们___来一些自己种的菜。
items.zh: 邻居敲门，给我们送来一些自己种的菜。
items.py: lín jū qiāo mén gěi wǒ men sòng lái yī xiē zì jǐ zhòng de cài
items.en: A neighbour knocked and brought us some vegetables from their own garden.
items.why: Bringing something to a door as a gift is 送. 寄 would mean it came by post, which 敲门 rules out, and 发 and 问 do not fit.

items.s: 外面在雨，你出门要带伞。
items.s_py: wài miàn zài yǔ nǐ chū mén yào dài sǎn
items.zh: 外面在下雨，你出门要带伞。
items.py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ nǐ chū mén yào dài sǎn
items.en: It's raining outside, so take an umbrella when you go out.
items.why: 雨 is a noun, so rain needs the verb 下 'fall': 在下雨.

items.s: 昨天晚上雨下得特别大，早上路上还有很多水。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang yǔ xià de tè bié dà zǎo shang lù shang hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
items.zh: 昨天晚上雨下得特别大，早上路上还有很多水。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang yǔ xià de tè bié dà zǎo shang lù shang hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
items.en: It rained very hard last night, and this morning there was still a lot of water on the road.
items.why: Heavy rain is 雨下得很大. 大 is the right word for rain, not 重 or 强.

items.q: 你找小王吗？他不在，你可以给他___言，请他回来以后给你回电话。
items.zh: 你找小王吗？他不在，你可以给他留言，请他回来以后给你回电话。
items.py: nǐ zhǎo xiǎo wáng ma tā bù zài nǐ kě yǐ gěi tā liú yán qǐng tā huí lái yǐ hòu gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
items.en: Are you looking for Xiao Wang? He's out; you can leave him a message and ask him to call you back.
items.why: A message left for someone is 留言. 取 is for collecting, 起 is for getting up, and 生 does not fit 言.

items.q: 妈妈晚上六点___班回来，顺便在超市买了菜。
items.zh: 妈妈晚上六点下班回来，顺便在超市买了菜。
items.py: mā ma wǎn shang liù diǎn xià bān huí lái shùn biàn zài chāo shì mǎi le cài
items.en: Mum got back from work at six in the evening and bought groceries at the supermarket on the way.
items.why: Finishing work is 下班, which fits coming home in the evening. 上班 is starting work, and 去班 and 做班 are not phrases.

items.s: 我叔叔会开飞机，他是飞行员。
items.s_py: wǒ shū shu huì kāi fēi jī tā shì fēi xíng yuán
items.zh: 我叔叔会开飞机，他是飞行员。
items.py: wǒ shū shu huì kāi fēi jī tā shì fēi xíng yuán
items.en: My uncle can fly planes; he's a pilot.
items.why: A pilot is the driver of the plane, so 开飞机 is right. 坐飞机 would make him only a passenger.

items.q: 妈妈每个周末都给奶奶___电话。
items.zh: 妈妈每个周末都给奶奶打电话。
items.py: mā ma měi gè zhōu mò dōu gěi nǎi nai dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Mum phones Grandma every weekend.
items.why: A phone call is made with 打: 给 + person + 打电话. 发 is for texts and emails, and 说 and 做 cannot take 电话 as an object.

items.s: 我每天早上六点钟取床，然后去跑步。
items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn zhōng qǔ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
items.zh: 我每天早上六点钟起床，然后去跑步。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn zhōng qǐ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
items.en: I get up at six every morning and then go running.
items.why: Getting up is 起床. 取 means to collect or withdraw.

items.q: 昨天夜里风很___，窗户都被吹开了。
items.zh: 昨天夜里风很大，窗户都被吹开了。
items.py: zuó tiān yè lǐ fēng hěn dà chuāng hu dōu bèi chuī kāi le
items.en: The wind was very strong last night and blew all the windows open.
items.why: Wind is 大 or 小. 重, 深 and 多 do not describe wind.

items.s: 这杯咖啡太强了，我晚上喝了会睡不着。
items.s_py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài qiáng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le huì shuì bù zháo
items.zh: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我晚上喝了会睡不着。
items.py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le huì shuì bù zháo
items.en: This coffee is too strong; if I drink it in the evening I won't be able to sleep.
items.why: Strong coffee is 浓. 强 describes power or ability, never a drink.

items.q: 他今年在北京___大学，学的是历史。
items.zh: 他今年在北京读大学，学的是历史。
items.py: tā jīn nián zài běi jīng dú dà xué xué de shì lì shǐ
items.en: This year he is studying at a university in Beijing, majoring in history.
items.why: 读大学 means to study at university. 看 means to look at something and 吃 is only for eating, so neither can describe studying.

items.q: 叔叔在上海___生意，一年只回家一两次。
items.zh: 叔叔在上海做生意，一年只回家一两次。
items.py: shū shu zài shàng hǎi zuò shēng yi yī nián zhǐ huí jiā yī liǎng cì
items.en: My uncle does business in Shanghai and only comes home once or twice a year.
items.why: Doing business is 做生意. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 开 and 发 do not combine with 生意.

items.q: 春节我们一家人要回奶奶家___年。
items.zh: 春节我们一家人要回奶奶家过年。
items.py: chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén yào huí nǎi nai jiā guò nián
items.en: At Spring Festival our whole family goes to Grandma's to celebrate the New Year.
items.why: 过年 is the fixed phrase for celebrating the New Year. 开 and 打 do not fit 年, and 看 is for seeing.

items.q: 孩子们放学回家，先___作业，然后才能玩。
items.zh: 孩子们放学回家，先做作业，然后才能玩。
items.py: hái zi men fàng xué huí jiā xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu cái néng wán
items.en: When the children get home from school they do their homework first and only then can they play.
items.why: Homework is done with 做: 做作业. 办 is for paperwork and 发 is for sending.

items.q: 老师让我们每天早上大声___课文。
items.zh: 老师让我们每天早上大声读课文。
items.py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men měi tiān zǎo shang dà shēng dú kè wén
items.en: The teacher tells us to read the text aloud every morning.
items.why: Reading aloud is 读 (or 念), and 大声 'loudly' shows it is aloud. 看 is silent looking, and 吃 and 抽 are mouth verbs for food and cigarettes.

items.s: 爸爸教我开自行车，现在我已经学会了。
items.s_py: bà ba jiāo wǒ kāi zì xíng chē xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le
items.zh: 爸爸教我骑自行车，现在我已经学会了。
items.py: bà ba jiāo wǒ qí zì xíng chē xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le
items.en: Dad taught me to ride a bike, and now I've learned.
items.why: You sit astride a bike, so 骑. 开 is for vehicles you drive from a seat, such as cars and buses.

items.s: 我们在公园里拿了很多照片，真漂亮。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ ná le hěn duō zhào piàn zhēn piào liang
items.zh: 我们在公园里拍了很多照片，真漂亮。
items.py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn zhēn piào liang
items.en: We took lots of photos in the park, and they look lovely.
items.why: Taking photos is 拍 (or 照). 拿 means to pick up or hold, so it cannot describe taking pictures.

items.s: 她正在房间里读小说，没有听见我们说话。
items.s_py: tā zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ dú xiǎo shuō méi yǒu tīng jiàn wǒ men shuō huà
items.zh: 她正在房间里读小说，没有听见我们说话。
items.py: tā zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ dú xiǎo shuō méi yǒu tīng jiàn wǒ men shuō huà
items.en: She's reading a novel in her room and didn't hear us talking.
items.why: 读 is not limited to reading aloud: 读小说 is a normal way to say reading a novel silently. 看小说 would be right too.

items.q: 老师问我昨天去哪儿了，我不好意思___这个问题。
items.zh: 老师问我昨天去哪儿了，我不好意思回答这个问题。
items.py: lǎo shī wèn wǒ zuó tiān qù nǎ r le wǒ bù hǎo yì si huí dá zhè ge wèn tí
items.en: The teacher asked where I was yesterday, and I was too embarrassed to answer.
items.why: A question put to you is answered with 回答. 解决 is for solving a problem, and 提 raises one.

items.q: 外面的雨下得很___，你等雨小一点儿再走吧。
items.zh: 外面的雨下得很大，你等雨小一点儿再走吧。
items.py: wài miàn de yǔ xià de hěn dà nǐ děng yǔ xiǎo yī diǎn r zài zǒu ba
items.en: It's raining hard outside; wait until it eases before you leave.
items.why: Heavy rain is 下得很大, light rain 下得很小. 重 and 强 are tempting from 'heavy' and 'strong', but rain is not described with them.

items.q: 他说话声音很___，我坐在后面一点儿也听不见。
items.zh: 他说话声音很小，我坐在后面一点儿也听不见。
items.py: tā shuō huà shēng yīn hěn xiǎo wǒ zuò zài hòu miàn yī diǎn r yě tīng bù jiàn
items.en: He speaks so quietly that I can't hear him at all from the back.
items.why: A quiet voice is 小 (a loud one is 大). 少 is for amounts, 短 is for length, and 浅 is for colour or depth.

items.q: 那次旅行给我留下了很___的印象，我到现在还记得。
items.zh: 那次旅行给我留下了很深的印象，我到现在还记得。
items.py: nà cì lǚ xíng gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng wǒ dào xiàn zài hái jì de
items.en: That trip left a deep impression on me, and I still remember it.
items.why: A strong impression is 深. 大 'big' and 重 'heavy' are word-for-word guesses that do not collocate with 印象.

items.q: 我今天要去银行___手续，下午才能回家。
items.zh: 我今天要去银行办手续，下午才能回家。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yào qù yín háng bàn shǒu xù xià wǔ cái néng huí jiā
items.en: I have to go to the bank today to sort out some paperwork and won't be home until the afternoon.
items.why: Formalities and paperwork are handled with 办: 办手续. 做 is for cooking, homework and dreams, and 发 is for sending.

items.q: 顾客对服务不太满意，向经理___了很多意见。
items.zh: 顾客对服务不太满意，向经理提了很多意见。
items.py: gù kè duì fú wù bù tài mǎn yì xiàng jīng lǐ tí le hěn duō yì jiàn
items.en: The customer was not very happy with the service and made a lot of complaints to the manager.
